data.cde_definition: Unique identifier assigned to the study within the sponsoring institution.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the study identifier?

data.cde_definition: Full name of the investigator primarily responsible for the study's scientific conduct.
data.preferred_question_text: Who is the principal investigator?

data.cde_definition: Date on which the approved study protocol was first activated for data collection.
data.preferred_question_text: On what date did the study begin?

data.cde_definition: The Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) protocol number authorizing this study.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the IACUC protocol number?

data.cde_definition: Unique identifier for an individual animal subject within the study.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the subject identifier?

data.cde_definition: Biological sex of the animal subject as identified at birth.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the sex of the subject?
data.pv_definitions: Male biological sex.|Female biological sex.|Biological sex not determined or not recorded.

data.cde_definition: Taxonomic species of the animal subject.
data.preferred_question_text: What species is the subject?
data.pv_definitions: Mus musculus (laboratory mouse).|Rattus norvegicus (laboratory rat).|Mustela putorius furo.|Sus scrofa domesticus (domestic pig).

data.cde_definition: Inbred or outbred strain designation for the subject, recorded using the standard nomenclature (e.g., C57BL/6J, Sprague-Dawley).
data.preferred_question_text: What is the subject's strain?

data.cde_definition: Genotype of the subject, including any transgenes, knockouts, or reporter alleles. Use standard allele nomenclature.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the subject's genotype?

data.cde_definition: Calendar date of the subject’s birth, or the known date of arrival if date of birth is unknown.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the subject's date of birth?

data.cde_definition: Numeric value of the subject's age at the time of the event being recorded.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the age of the subject?

data.cde_definition: Unit of time in which the subject's age is expressed.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the age recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Duration measured in days.|Duration measured in weeks.|Duration measured in months.|Duration measured in years.

data.cde_definition: Measured body mass of the subject.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the subject's body weight?

data.cde_definition: Unit of mass in which body weight is expressed.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the body weight recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Grams.|Kilograms.

data.cde_definition: The preclinical injury model used to induce traumatic brain or spinal cord injury.
data.preferred_question_text: Which injury model was used?
data.pv_labels: Controlled Cortical Impact|Fluid Percussion Injury|CHIMERA|Weight Drop|Spinal Cord Contusion|Sham
data.pv_definitions: Focal mechanical injury delivered by a computer-controlled impactor through a craniotomy.|Fluid pulse delivered to the intact dura through a craniotomy.|Closed-Head Impact Model of Engineered Rotational Acceleration — non-surgical closed-head injury.|Closed- or open-head injury from a weight dropped along a guide tube.|Impactor-based focal contusion of the spinal cord.|Surgical controls matched for anesthesia and craniotomy (or laminectomy) without injury delivery.

data.cde_definition: Calendar date on which the injury procedure was performed.
data.preferred_question_text: On what date was the injury performed?

data.cde_definition: Cerebral hemisphere on which the injury was delivered (for lateralized injury models).
data.preferred_question_text: On which hemisphere was the injury delivered?
data.pv_definitions: Left cerebral hemisphere.|Right cerebral hemisphere.|Both hemispheres.|Injury model is not lateralized (e.g., closed-head or spinal cord injury).

data.cde_definition: Linear velocity of the impactor tip at the moment of contact with the dural or cortical surface.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the impact velocity?

data.cde_definition: Unit of speed in which impact velocity is expressed.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the impact velocity recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Meters per second.|Millimeters per second.

data.cde_definition: The actuation mechanism used by the impactor to deliver the impact force.
data.preferred_question_text: Which type of impact actuator was used?
data.pv_definitions: Solenoid-driven impactor providing velocity-controlled contact.|Compressed-gas driven impactor.|Mechanical spring-driven impactor.|Actuator mechanism not captured by the above; specify separately.

data.cde_definition: Free-text specification of the impact actuator mechanism when "Other" is selected.
data.preferred_question_text: Specify the other impact actuator mechanism.

data.cde_definition: Anterior-posterior coordinate of the craniotomy center relative to bregma, in millimeters. Positive values are anterior.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the AP coordinate of the craniotomy (mm from bregma)?

data.cde_definition: Medial-lateral coordinate of the craniotomy center relative to the midline, in millimeters. Report the magnitude; hemisphere is recorded separately.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the ML coordinate of the craniotomy (mm from midline)?

data.cde_definition: Dorsal-ventral depth of the craniotomy from the cortical surface, in millimeters.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the depth of the craniotomy (mm)?

data.cde_definition: Diameter of the craniotomy opening, in millimeters.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the diameter of the craniotomy (mm)?

data.cde_definition: Pharmacologic agent used to induce or maintain general anesthesia during the procedure.
data.preferred_question_text: Which anesthetic agent was used?
data.pv_definitions: Volatile halogenated ether anesthetic.|Dissociative plus α2-agonist combination.|Barbiturate anesthetic.|2,2,2-tribromoethanol injectable anesthetic.|Agent not captured above.

data.cde_definition: Numeric dose of the anesthetic agent administered, expressed in the unit recorded in the paired unit CDE.
data.preferred_question_text: What dose of the anesthetic agent was administered?

data.cde_definition: Unit of measure for the anesthesia dose.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the anesthesia dose recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Milligrams of drug per kilogram of body mass.|Micrograms of drug per kilogram of body mass.|Absolute dose in milligrams.|Volume-percent concentration (for inhaled agents).

data.cde_definition: Route by which the anesthetic agent was administered.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the route of administration for the anesthetic?
data.pv_definitions: Injection into the peritoneal cavity.|Injection directly into a vein.|Injection into a muscle.|Injection beneath the skin.|Administration by mouth.|Administration via inhaled vapor or gas.

data.cde_definition: Generic or systematic name of the administered investigational or comparator compound.
data.preferred_question_text: What drug was administered?

data.cde_definition: Numeric value of the administered drug dose.
data.preferred_question_text: What dose of the drug was administered?

data.cde_definition: Unit of measure for the administered drug dose.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the drug dose recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Milligrams of drug per kilogram of body mass.|Micrograms of drug per kilogram of body mass.|Absolute dose in milligrams.|Volume-percent concentration (for inhaled agents).

data.cde_definition: Route by which the investigational drug was administered.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the route of administration?
data.pv_definitions: Injection into the peritoneal cavity.|Injection directly into a vein.|Injection into a muscle.|Injection beneath the skin.|Administration by mouth.|Administration via inhaled vapor or gas.

data.cde_definition: Measured body temperature of the subject at the time of recording.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the subject's body temperature?

data.cde_definition: Unit of temperature in which body temperature is expressed.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the body temperature recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Degrees Celsius.|Degrees Fahrenheit.

data.cde_definition: Method by which body temperature was measured.
data.preferred_question_text: How was the body temperature measured?
data.pv_definitions: Temperature measured via a rectal thermistor or probe.|Non-contact infrared surface temperature measurement.|Temperature recorded from a surgically implanted biotelemetry device.|Tympanic membrane temperature measurement.

data.cde_definition: Sampling frequency at which the EEG signal was digitized.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the EEG sampling rate?

data.cde_definition: Unit in which the EEG sampling rate is expressed.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the EEG sampling rate recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Hertz (samples per second).|Kilohertz (thousands of samples per second).

data.cde_definition: Total number of EEG recording channels used in the session, excluding reference and ground electrodes.
data.preferred_question_text: How many EEG channels were recorded?

data.cde_definition: Physical form factor of the EEG electrodes used during recording.
data.preferred_question_text: What type of EEG electrodes was used?
data.pv_definitions: Small screw electrode placed in the skull over the dura.|Electrode placed on the intact or reflected skin/skull surface.|Wire electrode advanced into brain parenchyma.|Flexible wire placed beneath the dura on the cortical surface.

data.cde_definition: Calendar date on which the seizure event was observed to begin.
data.preferred_question_text: On what date did the seizure begin?

data.cde_definition: Time of day at which the seizure event was observed to begin, in 24-hour format.
data.preferred_question_text: At what time did the seizure begin?

data.cde_definition: Precision with which the seizure onset timestamp is known.
data.preferred_question_text: How precisely was the seizure onset time determined?
data.pv_definitions: Onset identified to within one second on the EEG record.|Onset known to within one minute.|Onset known to within one hour.|Onset inferred from indirect evidence (cage check, video review).

data.cde_definition: ILAE-aligned classification of the observed seizure semiology.
data.preferred_question_text: What type of seizure was observed?
data.pv_definitions: Seizure arising from a localized region of one hemisphere.|Focal-onset seizure that evolves into bilateral tonic-clonic activity.|Generalized seizure with tonic stiffening followed by clonic jerking.|Brief behavioral arrest with generalized 3 Hz spike-and-wave on EEG.|Brief involuntary muscle jerks without loss of awareness.|Seizure detected on EEG without overt behavioral manifestation.|Insufficient information to classify.

data.cde_definition: Behavioral severity score for observed seizures, scaled 0-5 per the Racine (1972) classification.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the Racine score for the observed seizure?
data.pv_labels: 0 - No response|1 - Facial clonus|2 - Head nodding|3 - Forelimb clonus|4 - Rearing|5 - Rearing and falling
data.pv_definitions: No behavioral change.|Mouth and facial twitching.|Rhythmic head movement.|Unilateral or bilateral forelimb clonus.|Rearing with forelimb clonus.|Rearing, falling, generalized tonic-clonic activity.

data.cde_name: Morris Water Maze Escape Latency Value
data.cde_definition: Time from the start of a Morris Water Maze trial until the subject locates and mounts the hidden platform.
data.preferred_question_text: What was the escape latency for this trial?

data.cde_name: Morris Water Maze Escape Latency Unit
data.cde_definition: Unit of time in which the Morris Water Maze escape latency is expressed.
data.preferred_question_text: In what unit is the escape latency recorded?
data.pv_definitions: Seconds.|Milliseconds.

data.cde_definition: Sequential trial number within the Morris Water Maze session for this subject.
data.preferred_question_text: What is the trial number?

data.cde_definition: Calendar date on which the subject was euthanized for tissue collection or at study termination.
data.preferred_question_text: On what date was the subject euthanized?

data.cde_definition: Method used to euthanize the subject, consistent with the applicable AVMA guidelines.
data.preferred_question_text: How was the subject euthanized?
data.pv_definitions: Gradual-fill carbon dioxide asphyxiation.|Intraperitoneal barbiturate or equivalent overdose.|Perfusion with fixative under deep anesthesia (for histology).|Decapitation under anesthesia, per IACUC approval.|Cervical dislocation under anesthesia.

data.cde_definition: Unique identifier for a collected tissue sample (e.g., brain block, spinal cord segment, serum aliquot).
data.preferred_question_text: What is the tissue sample identifier?

data.cde_definition: Staining protocol applied to the tissue section for histological analysis.
data.preferred_question_text: Which staining protocol was used?
data.pv_definitions: Hematoxylin and eosin.|Nissl stain for neuronal cell bodies.|Fluorescent marker for degenerating neurons.|Immunohistochemistry for neuronal nuclei.|Immunohistochemistry for astrocytes.|Immunohistochemistry for microglia.

data.cde_definition: Calendar date on which a scheduled observation or assessment was conducted.
data.preferred_question_text: On what date was the observation made?
